entries.text: Then {npcname} vanished, and it turned up weeks later, {f:details}
It was stolen three times and came back stranger, {f:details}
A rival tried to destroy it; it survived, {f:details}
Every owner died young, and each left it the same way, {f:details}
It was buried with {npcname} and clawed back up, {f:details}
A devil collected on the bargain and left a signature, {f:details}
An archfey borrowed it for one dance and returned it a century later, {f:details}
A storm took the ship, but it washed ashore whole, {f:details}
It went into a dragon's lair with a hero and came out alone, {f:details}
A century in the ice changed it, {f:details}
An angel judged its owner and left the verdict on it, {f:details}
A mind flayer studied it for a year, then let it go, {f:details}
An apprentice tried to copy it, and the backlash marked it, {f:details}
It fell through a portal and came back, {f:details}
A beast dragged it into the wilds; it was found years later, {f:details}
